id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dea: "What was that all about? Wasn't Miko the shrine maiden who protects Hotto...?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1df9: "Hey, friend! With the monster and firedrake gone, merchants and tourists are coming again.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e06: "It's all thanks to Miko and Ryu... no, to Hotto's new hero, {var:1}. Thanks to you.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e16: "...Oh, traveler? They say strange things are happening worldwide. At times like this, rest in the steam bath.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e25: "Miko's hardly in the village lately, so maybe only the steam bath keeps our spirits up...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e35: "If Ryu had really died, Miko might have blamed herself and fallen ill in spirit...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e41: "We'd left the village's future to Miko and Ryu. From now on, we'll all support the two of them.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e9b: "I came to this village to spread the gods' teaching, but here a shrine maiden named Miko seems to be the god. Well then...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eaf: "A-at times like this, stay calm and pray to the gods! Inhale... exhale... inhale... exhale...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ec1: "With the shrine maiden Miko gone, the villagers are quite downcast. Let us pray to our own god. Well then...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ed6: "Though they lost their shrine maiden Miko, the villagers are livelier than before. How resilient. Well then...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ee9: "I came to spread the gods' teaching, but it's grown dangerous outside. I'm stuck here a while. Sigh...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa2: "I never want to say goodbye to Mama. So please save Mama!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1faf: "The bad firedrake was alive? What does that mean!? Was Miko a liar...?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fb7: "I'll be good here, so please ask Miko for the truth...

id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fcc: "Maybe the old woman at Miko's house knows how to get to the bad dragon?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd9: "Is Miko a bad person or a good person... which is it? I don't know anymore.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fe2: "But watching Atsuo, I started thinking we should all work hard to protect Hotto.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ff3: "Hee hee, no way! I won't get caught by monsters!
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2002: "When Miko came back with Ryu, her eyes were a little red... Was Miko crying?
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|200c: "If Mama disappeared I'd be so sad, so I understand... Miko must have been so hurt.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2098: "The evil firedrake dwelling on Mount Huji... devouring and menacing people, ready to devour even Hotto.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20a4: "Then came the shrine maiden Miko and swordsman Ryu, bravely facing the firedrake, and Ryu cast away his own life.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20b2: "We, the people of Hotto, under Miko's protection, shall be with the soul of the late swordsman Ryu...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20c6: "The man-eating firedrake that once lived on Mount Huji attacked our people time and again... Hotto nearly perished.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20d5: "But Miko, our chief, faced the firedrake with her son, the swordsman Ryu, and slew it.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20e3: "Ryu lost his life, but we of Hotto, under Miko's protection, remain with Ryu's soul...
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20f6: "...Did you flee from the firedrake too? Stay inside and even the firedrake shouldn't attack.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2101: "If it comes for this house, it won't touch my grandchild. I'll hold it off even as a shield.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2112: "See, you were safe inside, weren't you? The bad firedrake fled, so there's no need to fear.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|211f: "Glad you're safe too, traveler. I can't bear to see any more young people die...

tm.「以前 ヒノノギ火山に棲んでいた 人食い火竜は\n ことあるごとに この里の人間: "The man-eating firedrake that once lived on Mount Huji attacked our people time and again... Hotto nearly perished.
tm.「しかし 里の長である巫女 ヤヤクさまが\n 息子である 剣士のハリマさまと共に: "But Miko, our chief, faced the firedrake with her son, the swordsman Ryu, and slew it.
tm.「ハリマさまは 命を落としてしまいましたが\n 我ら ホムラの民は ヤヤクさまの: "Ryu lost his life, but we of Hotto, under Miko's protection, remain with Ryu's soul...
tm.「……あんたも 火竜から逃げてきたのかい？\n 家の中にいれば さしもの火竜も\: "...Did you flee from the firedrake too? Stay inside and even the firedrake shouldn't attack.
tm.「もし この家を狙いにきても\n ウチの孫に 手は出させないさ。\n 私が盾にな: "If it comes for this house, it won't touch my grandchild. I'll hold it off even as a shield.
tm.「ほら 家の中にいれば 大丈夫だったろう？\n 悪い火竜は 逃げていったから\n: "See, you were safe inside, weren't you? The bad firedrake fled, so there's no need to fear.
tm.「旅人さんも 無事だったようで なによりだよ。\n もう これ以上 若い人が\n: "Glad you're safe too, traveler. I can't bear to see any more young people die...
tm.「ホムラの里を守る 巫女の命も\n その血筋も ついえて……\n 火山に住まう: "The shrine maiden who guarded Hotto is gone, her bloodline ended... and the man-eating firedrake is slain.
tm.「残ったのは 私ら ホムラの民だけじゃ……。\n もはや 何も頼ることができない: "Only we of Hotto remain... In a world with no one to rely on, we must help one another to live.
tm.「ホムラの里を守る 巫女ヤヤクさまも\n その血筋である ハリマさまの命も\n: "We couldn't protect Miko, who guarded Hotto, nor Ryu of her bloodline...
tm.「勇者さまは そんな ホムラの里の者も\n 魔王から 守ってくださったのですね…: "Yet the hero protected even the people of Hotto from the Dark One... How strong and kind you are.
tm.「里の外では あちこちで\n おそろしい魔物が 目覚めているそうだけど\n 子供: "I hear fearsome monsters are awakening all over outside. I only hope the children stay safe...

tm.「いくら火竜が倒されても 誰かがいないようじゃ\n やっぱり 心から 笑うことは: "Slaying the firedrake wasn't enough while someone was missing. With Ryu safe, our gatherings are back.
tm.「この里は 魔物に狙われていたそうだけど\n 騒ぎが おさまってきたから\n 新: "I hear this village was targeted by monsters, but the uproar has died down, so we came on our honeymoon.
tm.「世界が 大変な時だからこそ\n 愛を大事にして 生きていこうと思ってな。\n: "Precisely because the world is in turmoil, I want to live cherishing love. So I took the plunge and proposed to her.
tm.「天才情報屋とかいう ヘンな男に聞いたんだが\n この里の人たちは ちょっと前ま: "A strange man calling himself a genius informant told me these folks lived in fear of a man-eating firedrake until recently.
tm.「ああして 楽しそうに\n 蒸し風呂に入ってる女たちを見ていると\n そんな話: "Seeing the women enjoying the steam bath so happily, that story sounds like a lie.
tm.「彼女との新婚旅行で この里に来たら\n サマディー王国に 異変が起きたそうでな: "We came to this village on our honeymoon, and something happened in Gallopolis... Now we can't go home.
tm.「蒸し風呂に入るくらいしか やることがないし\n このままじゃ オレも 彼女も\: "Nothing to do but take steam baths. At this rate both of us will get soggy and soft.

tm.「この里は ちょっと前まで 人食い火竜とか\n 化け物とかに おびやかされていた: "This village was menaced by a man-eating firedrake and monsters until recently, but now it seems safe.
tm.「また 身体が冷めてきちゃったわ……。\n どうせ 他に することもないんだから: "My body's cooled again... There's nothing else to do, so let's take another steam bath.

tm.「ハリマさまも ヤヤクさまもいなくなった\n この里に もう 希望はない。\n: "Ryu and Miko are gone. This village has no hope left. We'll all be eaten by the firedrake...
